_comment: Creature models built by tools/blender/build_creatures.py and checked by tools/blender/validate.ts. One entry per species with a rigged GLB. key = file name in public/models and SPECIES[..].model.key in src/sim/species.ts. recipe = tools/blender/creatures/<recipe>.py. scale = authored units -> tiles (kept as the armature's scale). top = allowed height of the top of the model in tiles after scaling. floats = hovering creature (its lowest point may be above the ground). Units: 1 = 1 tile, origin at the feet centre, front = +Z (glTF).
